purpose: Improve playing strength under the current client inference budget; distinguish teacher coverage, learning objective and search effects.

evidence.interpretation: No confirmed gain; small screening losses do not establish every rejected idea is intrinsically inferior.

sources.use: Candidate sampling and completed-Q policy targets; practical strength guarantee does not follow for approximate Q.
Separate final action selection from all-legal-action training weights.
Randomized playout caps and optional future-action auxiliary targets.
Training-only auxiliary head for softened policy targets; developer evidence, not a standalone controlled v3 study.
State-diversity motivation; abstract verified, shogi experiment, not evidence of Go gain.

metrics: Teacher support size (>0 and >=1e-4), entropy, top2 mass and mass outside top2
Teacher mass and best-action recall inside baseline NN prior top8/top16; report mean/median/p10 per board
Stratify by teacher source, turn fraction, immediate captures and low-liberty groups; tactical labels are diagnostics, not teacher truth
Inspect policy eligibility, validationPolicy semantics, duplicate roots, connected game/fork split leakage
Reported L6 fixture: capture6, prior rank and searched status, diagnostic only
phase0.softHeadSkipRule: Skip phase1 if fewer than10% of eligible training positions have >=1% teacher probability outside top2. This is a resource heuristic, not proof that auxiliary learning cannot help.
phase0.integrityFailure: Stop affected learning until provenance/split/label issues are resolved and a revised plan is recorded before training.

prerequisites: Soft-head skip rule does not fire
Source, plan, data and split hashes recorded before training
phase1.target: On eligible legal actions only, normalize pi^(1/4). Exact teacher zeros stay zero; no epsilon smoothing or new target support.
phase1.head: Independent per-node and pass MLP heads matching the ordinary policy-head shapes; training only. Reuse the entire trunk. No change to ordinary policy target.
phase1.loss: Existing weighted loss plus lambda*soft cross entropy with identical eligibility and within-domain policy normalization; auxiliary term excluded from common validation/checkpoint selection.
phase1.initialization: Resume the original checkpoint for every run. Initialize the auxiliary head from the resumed policy/passing heads; use a separate RNG stream so its construction cannot alter paired minibatch order. Control uses the same training graph with lambda0.

training.checkpointSelection: Lowest common baseline-format validation loss; ties prefer earlier epoch. No auxiliary loss in the score.

rules: Control lambda0 numerically reproduces the ordinary continuation path
Auxiliary gradients reach trunk; illegal/padded actions are masked; zeros stay zero
Removing auxiliary heads preserves policy/value/score/ownership outputs
Export has the original120905-parameter inference architecture and ABI
Actual nine-board CPU/WebGPU Worker numerical parity passes
preflight.appliesTo: Loss-improvement and positive-epoch gates apply to Soft4 only. Control must pass integrity/numerical/export checks, may select epoch0 and remains available as the causal comparator even without improvement.

development.candidateEligibility: Both Soft4 replicas pass preflight and each scores>=40/72, >=3/8 per board, plane>=50%, curve>=50% against deployed baseline. Mean Soft4 match score across replicas must exceed mean Control; if a paired Control is unavailable, stop causal selection.
development.modelSelection: Freeze replica with training seed2026102810 as the only possible adoption candidate before matches. Replica2 is replication evidence, never a replacement chosen by outcome.
development.diagnostics: Compare Soft4-Control deltas in common policy KL and teacher top8 mass/recall; report regressions without changing gates.

independent.note: A successful test supports selected model vs deployed baseline, not a separate formal proof that the auxiliary method beats Control.

phase1.stopping: No hyperparameter sweep, extra replicas, holdout extension or replacement candidate after failure. Archive all runs and conclude the round.

phase2.start: Only after phase1 is skipped or its decision is archived; freeze a separate plan before collecting/training or viewing new match outcomes.

workPackages.hypothesis: More varied fresh experience and better-covered teachers help more than replaying the old corpus.
workPackages.design: Control old data vs old+new data, same training objective and deployment search. Plane KataGo labels; curved boards use only a separately validated topology-correct teacher. Split by origin game including every fork. Pilot and freeze exact budgets before full generation.

workPackages.hypothesis: Training on a completed-Q all-legal policy avoids treating every unexplored or eliminated root action as zero.
workPackages.design: On exactly the same stored roots and search traces, compare current finalist-only targets vs completed-Q targets with mixed value and declared Q transform. Freeze candidate extraction, visits and model. Separate action recommendation from training target. Reject any claim that imputation discovers unsearched tactical wins.

workPackages.hypothesis: Sampling without replacement during self-play gives low-prior moves training exposure.
workPackages.design: After target semantics are validated, compare deterministic top8 vs Gumbel top8 at identical64-visit generation budget; use the same completed-Q target and training recipe. Keep evaluation noise0 and deployment candidate count8. Measure training exposure and final deterministic top8 recall.

registrationMustSpecify: Fixed deployed baseline for the round, teacher identity/strength/provenance, source/model hashes
Pilot limit and measured cost, total game/root/teacher-query/training-step ceilings
Playout-cap probabilities/budgets, branching procedure, old/new mixture and data splits
Complete mixed-value/rescale formula, zero-visit behaviour, legality masking and proof overrides
Separate training, development, independent and bootstrap seeds not used by prior rounds
One-factor contrasts, max candidate count, selection rule and independent stop rule
nonGoals: Repeat failed root-count/Q sweeps without new evidence
Train on previous independent games or the reported L6 fixture

matches.cappedGames: Retain in evaluation; replay and score actual Game position; report caps per arm
matches.score: Actual Game area score; draw half point
matches.audit: Replay every move, verify legality, actors, topology, scores and exact search budget; no outcome-dependent exclusions
matches.primary: 64 visits per move on all nine boards
matches.secondary: Selected model equal-time paired development benchmark; calibrate fixed time budget using baseline alone before candidate timing. Freeze the procedure and fresh seeds before running; no outcome-based budget changes.

latency.fixture: Freeze27 ordinary roots from first-replica development Control games at N/4,N/2,3N/4 and reported/pass/proof stress roots before timing.
latency.condition: Alternate baseline/candidate, quiet environment, include restore/search/yields and exclude diagnostic logs.
latency.mobile: If no real mobile measurement exists, explicitly report PC-only evidence; do not claim phone latency.

deliverables: Frozen plan and source hashes, coverage audit, implementation correctness report
Four complete training logs/checkpoints including negative runs, common selection metrics
Development games, at most one independent result, paired CI and per-board breakdown
Export parity, latency/equal-time evidence with environment, replay audit, archive manifest and final decision
permissions: This change records the plan only. No experiment execution, production asset replacement, commit, push or deployment in this planning task.
